Clean data from datalibweb structure (High level)

pd_dlw_clean.Rd

Clean data from datalibweb structure (High level)

Usage

pd_dlw_clean(
  ls,
  verbose = getOption("pipdata.verbose", TRUE),
  recode_spec = NULL
)

Arguments

ls

List of data frames or single dataframe.

verbose

Logical. Print progress messages. Default: getOption("pipdata.verbose", TRUE).

recode_spec

Optional pre-resolved recode spec (as returned by sync_recode_spec()) threaded down to apply_recode_spec() so the spec is read once upstream instead of once per survey. Default NULL (each survey reads the spec from stamp).

Value

list with data.tables

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
release <- "20250203"
pipfun::setup_working_release(release)

pfw  <- pipload::pip_load_aux("pfw")

gd    <- pipload::pip_load_dlw("CHN", 2015)
gd  <- survey_id_to_attr(gd, unique(gd$survey_id))
ls    <- pd_cpfw_merge(gd, pfw)
lf    <- pd_dlw_clean(ls)
names(lf)

md    <- pipload::pip_load_dlw(country = "PHL", 2012)
md  <- survey_id_to_attr(md, unique(md$survey_id))
ls    <- pd_cpfw_merge(md, pfw)
lf    <- pd_dlw_clean(ls)
names(lf)
} # }
